thread:
Nate (CS): quick capture from today's Acme onboarding call — they asked for a couple product changes before renewal check-in.
Maya (PM): ok drop the notes here pls. what are the asks?
Nate (CS): two main asks: 1) per-route cost CSV export so their finance team can break down chargebacks; 2) a toggle for default model per-team (they want cheaper gen for support workflows). Also they flagged embeddings staleness on cached docs.
Ben (Eng): CSV export sounds straightforward. do we have a sample schema?
Nate (CS): sample from the call (rough): `project_id,route_name,model,token_count,unit_cost,period_start,period_end`. we can add `customer_tag` column.
Leo (Product): thanks. how urgent? renewal is coming up?
Nate (CS): renewal check-in in ~45 days. Acme said unclear cost visibility is a top renewal risk — classify export as P0/P1.
Maya (PM): agree: export = P1, default-model toggle = P2, embeddings-staleness detection = P2. can engineering do a mini-sprint for the export?
Ben (Eng): we can do an endpoint + background job to spool CSV. estimate: 1 dev + 0.5 QA, 8-10 working days to M+1 if scoped tightly.
Sam (CS-triage-bot): @Maya created ticket CS-4219: "Acme per-route cost CSV export" with tags [export, billing, renewal-risk].
Maya (PM): perfect. Ben can you add an API surface (GET /billing/exports/:id) + sample CSV headers in the ticket? pls include auth scope.
Ben (Eng): yep — will add endpoint spec + sample.
Nate (CS): CS enablement request: once we have a beta build, want a 30-min walk-through for their finance and ops. also need a one-pager showing columns and mapping to their GL codes.
Maya (PM): add enablement work to the ticket as a checklist: doc, walkthrough, sample data. Samira, can CS own the walkthrough scheduling? (cc @Sam)
Sam (CS-triage-bot): Assigned CS task -> CS-4220.
Leo (Product): prioritize feature in roadmap lane "renewal-risk mitigation". if export shipped, follow-up metric: % of accounts with CSV download > 0 within 14 days of availability.
Nate (CS): noted. also they asked about per-team default model — small UX: dropdown in team settings. low friction.
Ben (Eng): ok will spec toggle as separate PR, aim for next sprint.
Maya (PM): for prioritization, do we need a quick ROI calc? estimate: prevents one churn (ACV ~$90k) if it keeps them happy — worth P1.
Nate (CS): agree. final note: customer asked for sample payload for mapping token_cost -> currency. include currency_code column.
Ben (Eng): will add `currency_code` to CSV.
Maya (PM): timeline: ticket created, spec by EOD Wed, eng tickets ready by next Mon, enablement draft same week.
Nate (CS): thanks all — I'll follow up with Acme to confirm walkthrough availability and share ticket links. :thumbsup:
Ben (Eng): :thumbsup: ping me in the ticket for any schema clarifications.
Leo (Product): great — mark this as "pilot-led" and add to the renewal warboard.
Sam (CS-triage-bot): Reaction: :white_check_mark:
